steps.name: sync-exact-head
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git fetch origin main; test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "c6bf72310289c88b9644723ce8635c5288cad6f6"; git checkout -B main origin/main; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "c6bf72310289c88b9644723ce8635c5288cad6f6"; git status --short

steps.name: verify-s22-identity
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; adb devices -l; test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state)" = device; MODEL="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')"; test "$MODEL" = SM-S906B; printf 's22_identity_ok=true\nmodel=%s\n' "$MODEL"

steps.name: install-exact-head
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r app/build/outputs/apk/androidTest/debug/app-debug-androidTest.apk; printf 'exact_head_installed=true\n'

steps.name: run-redacted-enrollment-disclosure-proof
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; OUT="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am instrument -w -r -e class pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.identity.AndroidPhoneEnrollmentDisclosureContractTest pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner)"; printf '%s
' "$OUT"; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q '^OK (1 test)' || { printf 'phone_enrollment_s22_proof=false
' >&2; exit 1; }; printf 'phone_enrollment_s22_proof=true
'

steps.name: leave-app-ready-for-local-manual-enrollment
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell monkey -p pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null; printf 'main_activity_opened=true\nreal_phone_not_transported=true\n'
